```yaml
name: Devin session on label

on:
  issues:
    types: [labeled]

jobs:
  create-session:
    if: ${{ github.event.label.name == 'devin' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Create Devin session
        env:
          DEVIN_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.DEVIN_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          ISSUE_TITLE=$(jq -r '.issue.title' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH")
          ISSUE_URL=$(jq -r '.issue.html_url' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH")
          ISSUE_BODY=$(jq -r '.issue.body' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH")
          PROMPT="Issue: $ISSUE_TITLE\nURL: $ISSUE_URL\nBody: $ISSUE_BODY"
          JSON=$(jq -n --arg prompt "$PROMPT" '{"prompt":$prompt}')
          RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X POST https://api.devin.ai/v1/sessions \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEVIN_API_KEY" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "$JSON")
          SESSION_URL=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.url')
          echo "SESSION_URL=$SESSION_URL" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Comment on issue
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        env:
          SESSION_URL: ${{ env.SESSION_URL }}
        with:
          script: |
            const issueNumber = context.issue.number;
            const sessionUrl = process.env.SESSION_URL;
            await github.issues.createComment({
              ...context.repo,
              issue_number: issueNumber,
              body: `A Devin session has been created: ${sessionUrl}`
            });
```
